newsitem.title: USA: O'Sullivan completes Melnor unit sale.
newsitem.headline: O'Sullivan completes Melnor unit sale.

text.p: O'Sullivan Corp said Monday it completed the sale of its Melnor Inc subsidiary to Gardena Holding AG of Ulm, Germany.

The company said the sale --first announced July 17-- of the manufacturer of lawn and garden water products will result in an after-tax gain of about $0.21 a share in the third quarter and leave the company with no debt and $30 million in cash.
O'Sullivan added it will use some of the cash to finance "small acquisitions related to its core plastics division business."
The company posted a net of $3.3 million, or $0.21 a share, in the second quarter, compared with a $4.2 million net, or $0.26 a share, the year before.
Shares of the manufacturer of vinyl covers for cars, medical and office products traded unchanged at 10-1/8 Monday afternoon.
